headline: Voter checklist updates, 30-day letters, and Deputy Registrars for the November 3, 2026 State General Election.
summary: The board will review voter checklist changes, approve the City Clerk sending 30-Day letters, and approve the list of Deputy Registrars for the State General Election.
items: Accept voter checklist additions, deletions, and changes from September 8, 2026 through October 23, 2026
Approve City Clerk sending 30-Day letters as needed from November 4, 2026 through February 28, 2027
Approve the list of Deputy Registrars for the November 3, 2026 State General Election and allow the City Clerk to appoint more if needed
location: City Clerk's Office, One City Hall Plaza (1st Floor)
plain_text:
BOARD OF REGISTRARS 
October 23, 2026 at 4:45 PM 
City Clerk's Office, One City Hall Plaza (1st Floor) 
 
Members: Marc Gagnon, William Houghton, Mark Tremblay, Elizabeth Wester,  
Matthew Normand. 
 
AGENDA 
 
The Chairman calls the meeting to order. 
  
 
The Clerk calls the roll. 
  
 
1. Acceptance of the voter checklist additions, deletions, and changes from 
September 8, 2026 through October 23, 2026. 
Ladies and Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
 
2. Approval for the City Clerk to send 30-Day letters as deemed necessary from 
November 4, 2026 through February 28, 2027. 
Ladies and Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
 
3. Approval of the list of Deputy Registrars scheduled to work the November 3, 
2026 State General Election and for the City Clerk to appoint additional Deputy 
Registrars if necessary . 
Ladies and Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
 
If there is no further business, a motion is in order to adjourn.
